agentGuidance.summary: Read this manifest before using any file in public/assets/. Prefer webReady assets (typically .webp or lightweight .svg) for web pages. Never embed unreviewed or multi-megabyte gallery/ files in production HTML/CSS.

routes.signature: Route 01 — Signature ribbons (petrol teal dominant, oxblood secondary, selective metallic gold, luminous nodes)
routes.quiet: Route 02 — Quiet ribbons (simplified 2-3 broad ribbons, minimal texture and glow)
routes.gold: Route 03 — Gold filaments and flares (fine warm-gold threads and small crisp flares only, no filled ribbons)
